coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Twelve attacks run, none landed. Custody is clean: 018e0055 at 0444 unmoved, dispatch and prompt agreeing, HEAD never left fb6ba1f, file 08 at 23cdf039 and COORD at e4ec0f6c with a clean tree, all seven file pins plus the D-148 commit pin reproducing, and the gate table still at 23 rows with no DR-G24. The entry records what it says it records. Its seven classes set-compare equal to the artifact's, NT-4 is absent from both with its D-148 standing expressly not retargeted, and all five proposed kind names appear verbatim and stay candidate-not-adopted. My own leftover verdict is represented exactly at ACCEPT 0/0 with no advisories attributed to me; the Codex half I confirmed only as a digest. Every dispatch prohibition is refused in terms, including the three specific to this family — no G24 or later identifier, no G17 restoration, no D9 invention — and the readiness recital matches the post-D-147 register on all three figures. One thing I traced rather than assumed: the artifact requires that later acts add named DR-G* rows, which is the precondition that closes the condition-4 flip I raised as CLAUDE-PONAL-V1-ADV1, and Decision 4 does not repeat the word named. It carries the precondition structurally instead, by calling each later act a scoped D-002 / D-086 required-now successor — D-086 being the naming decision, the same construction D-147 used when it named the identifier in the same act as the row — and by conditioning on required-now membership, which is the only case where the denominator could move. Three items are recorded as considered and declined. After this entry, seven DR-131 NT classes remain leftover-design with no obligation; DR-131 stays OPEN, not eligible in kind, not SATISFIED.
